english.note: Use 嚿 as the colloquial choice for an irregular lump or chunk, including a tangible piece of something.

exampleSentences.english: I can't finish this piece of chocolate.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gau6 zyu1 gu1 lik6 ngo5 sik6 m4 saai3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a squat, thick, irregular piece of solid material.

exampleSentences.english: I bought a chunk of wood to make a little stand.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我買咗一嚿木頭返嚟整架仔。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gau6 muk6 tau4 faan1 lei4 zing2 gaa3 zai2
